answer_1.quote: We propose a Text-guided Audio Spatialization (TAS) framework, providing a more flexible and interactive control to map monaural audios to binaural ones.
answer_1.outputs: binaural audio from monaural audio and text prompts

answer_2.quote: During evaluation, we use both generation metrics and understanding metrics to assess the generated binaural audio. The generation quality metrics include Fréchet Distance (FD), Fréchet Audio Distance (FAD), Kullback-Leibler Divergence (KL), and Inception Score (IS).

answer_3.quote: We fine-tune the Llama-3.1-8B model on SpatialTAS, integrating the pretrained SpatialAudioEncoder to extract spatial audio features. Secondly, we send the ground-truth binaural audio and our generated binaural audio to the assessment model along with the corresponding spatial questions, obtaining the prediction accuracy discrepancy between them.
